name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Client Account Management | Multi-Industry Portfolios, Program Delivery & Building Client Services from Scratch
summary: Client account manager with 15+ years in SaaS, MarTech, and agency environments, owning portfolios that span healthcare, home services, retail, and professional services. Runs client programs from intake and scoping through delivery and follow-up, keeps concurrent engagements on track, and builds the playbooks, workflows, and team structure where none existed, including a new Wix vertical that went from proof of concept to profitable. Retained all but one of 15-20 reseller partners at Birdeye (~94%), including agencies serving healthcare clients, and led onboarding teams of up to 30. Hands-on in HubSpot and Salesforce.

experience.title: Client Services & Account Management (Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead)
bullets: Built a client services practice from scratch, defining intake, discovery, onboarding, and reporting standards for a portfolio of service businesses.
Own each client relationship from scoping through delivery, writing proposals and statements of work and expanding engagements as new needs surface.
Document every client interaction, timeline, and deliverable in HubSpot, GoHighLevel, and Notion, keeping records auditable across concurrent engagements.
Built reusable templates and automated workflows for confirmations, reminders, and follow-ups so delivery scales without losing the personal touch.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Led multi-stakeholder accounts as strategic lead, coordinating execution across internal departments and delivering QBRs with performance reporting.
Managed ~3 client accounts at $20K+/month in ad spend each (peaking above $100K/month), resolving client feedback promptly to protect retention.

experience.title: Client Success & Partner Management (Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding)
bullets: Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners (deals ~$10K-$45K) across health, home services, and retail, including agencies focused on healthcare clients, retaining all but one (~94% retention).
Analyzed partner utilization to spot adoption gaps and at-risk accounts early, recommending interventions that reduced churn.
Built scalable communication workflows and automated training sequences that reduced onboarding friction across the partner network.
Brought structured, prioritized client feedback to Product and Engineering to shape the roadmap.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Ran client accounts end to end, including a banking-industry client, and built processes that improved reporting accuracy and reduced cross-team handoff errors.
Led the sales team alongside individual account work.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Helped build a new vertical from proof of concept to a profitable business line, leading team initiatives and process improvements and contributing to hiring, onboarding, and training new team members.
Led multiple onboarding teams of up to 30 specialists, piloting different team structures as the vertical scaled.
Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, managing ~25 concurrent onboardings at peak, at 120% of sales and 110% of implementation targets.
Managed a high-value portfolio across diverse verticals, contributing to a 25% conversion improvement across the e-commerce segment.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Advised C-suite executives at agencies and professional-services firms, including international clients, as a trusted advisor on operational system design.
Built sequenced implementation plans for incoming clients and handed them to the implementation team to execute.
Ranked top three of 8 to 15 reps for most of a 27-month tenure while quota roughly doubled.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Ran full-cycle sales of a loyalty and marketing platform to small businesses, closing up to 10 deals/month.

experience.title: Business Development Representative
bullets: Qualified leads and booked meetings for regional representatives at a company focused on healthcare for seniors.
